title: Compound Interest by the Numbers: $1,000 Becomes $7,612
description:
At 7 percent a year for 30 years, 1,000 dollars grows to about 7,612 dollars. The maths: 1,000 x 1.07^30 = 7,612.

Graphics and narration were generated with AI. The maths is shown so you can check it yourself.

#money #investing #maths #shorts

scenes.vo: Here is why starting early matters so much. Put one thousand dollars away at seven percent a year.
